mentions.name: Nanosecond-scale stability project
mentions.description: A work-in-progress project that must remain stable at the nanosecond scale. Roughly two months into development, with slow but ongoing progress on a deep subject full of tricky details.
mentions.source_excerpt: I never suspected the amount of hard work that goes into building something that is stable at the nano second scale.
